email-recovery-description: Layini yin'we eka muamukeri un'wana ni un'wana. Lava hi ID ya mutirhisi. Vundzeni bya mahungu ni tindhawu ta imeyili ya muamukeri a swi kombisiwi. Ku yimisa swa xinkarhana ku khoma mahungu lama nga kona ni lama nga ta ta; ku ya mahlweni ku ringeta ku rhumela mahungu ya le layinini sweswi. Ku khansela ku susa mahungu lama nghenisiweke elayinini ku fikela enkarhini wa xikombelo. Loko ku rhumela ku ri karhi ku ya mahlweni, ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka nkarhi wo koma. Mahungu lama se ma rhumeriwaka a ma nge tlherisiwi, naswona ku rhumela loku nga tiyisisiwangiki ku nga ha phindhiwa. Ku tsandzeka ka nkarhi hinkwawo ni mahungu lama fikeleleke mpimo wa ku ringeta swi hlayisiwa leswaku swi ta kamberiwa. Ku ringeta nakambe mahungu lama tsandzekeke ku sungula nongonoko lowuntshwa wa ku ringeta naswona ku hlayisa ku yimisiwa ka xinkarhana loku nga kona.
email-recovery-empty: A ku na mahungu elayinini kumbe vaamukeri lava ku rhumela ka vona ku yimisiweke swa xinkarhana.
email-recovery-failed: Tirho a wu kotanga ku tiyisisiwa. Pfuxeta layini kutani u ringeta nakambe tirho wolowo loko swi laveka.
email-recovery-pending: Swi rindzile kumbe swi ringetiwa nakambe
email-recovery-superseded: Tirho lowuntshwa wa mutirhisi wa sisiteme wu sive xikombelo lexi. Ku kombisiwa xiyimo xa sweswi xa layini.
email-recovery-unavailable: A swi koteki ku hlaya layini ya ti-imeyili. Kambela mpfumelelo wa mulawuri ni ku kumeka ka sevha.

Tikhalomu ti hlayiwa hi mavito ya tona ya Xinghezi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): loko akhawunti ya wena yi tirhisa ririmi rin'wana, cinca mavito ya layini ya le henhla ma va hi Xinghezi ku sungula. Column yi va minxaxamelo naswona Lane yi va tindlela; vini, swikombiso, muhlovo, masiku, mimbulavulo na tilinki ta vatswari swi hlayisa tindhawu ta swona, naswona Priority, Size, Type na tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.

Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo, minxaxamelo ya ClickUp yi va tindlela, naswona mintirho yi va makhadi swin'we na swintirhwana, vaaveriwa, swikombiso, masiku, nkoka na nkarhi.

Goza leri landzelaka ri komba leswaku kholomu yin'wana na yin'wana i nsimu yihi. Phepha rin'wana na rin'wana leri nga na layini ya tinhloko ri hundzuka bodo.

Xihlawulekisi xo hlanganisa hi mintlawa eka xivono xa bodo xi hundzuka minxaxamelo, swihlawulekisi swin’wana swo hlawula swi hundzuka swikombiso, swiphemu swa tsalwa ni mabokisi yo fungha swi hundzuka nhlamuselo ni nxaxamelo wo kambela, naswona mavonelo ma hlayisiwa. Swifaniso ni swiengetelo a swi nghenisiwi.

Tikholomu ti hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi hundzuka tikhadi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Eka Kanri, pfula Import & Export u hlawula Export individual board (kumbe Export all data), kutani u namarhela fayili ya .json. Tikhalomu ti va minxaxamelo naswona makhadi ma va makhadi, swin'we na nhlamuselo, siku ro hetelela, swikombiso na mihlovo ya wona; mintirho ya khadi yi va nxaxamelo wo kambela. Eka ku humesa ka data hinkwayo ku nghenisiwa bodo yo sungula.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namarheta xivumbeko xa Leo (fayili ya .leo). Swiphemu swa xiyimo xa le henhla swi hundzuka minxaxamelo, swiphemu leswi nga ehansi ka swona hi ku kongoma swi hundzuka makhadi, naswona tsalwa ra xiphemu ri va nhlamuselo ya khadi. Swiphemu swa swiyimo leswi dzikeke swi hundzuka minxaxamelo yo kambela. Swiphemu leswi funghiweke swi nghenisiwa swi ri leswi hetiweke.
import-board-instruction-linear: Eka Linear, humesa swiphiqo tanihi CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kumbe ku humesa ka langutelo), kutani u namarhela CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo, mintlawa yi va tindlela, naswona swiphiqo swi va makhadi swin'we na muaveriwa, swikombiso, masiku, xiphiqo xa mutswari, nkoka, xilinganiso, phurojeke na xirhendzevutani.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela nkarhi wa mintirho ya markdown (ndlela leyi swiendlakalo swa markdown-kanban swo fana na Obsidian Kanban swi yi tirhisaka): tinhloko ta "## Vito ra nkarhi", ni swilo swa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ehansi. Tinhloko ti va tinxaxamelo naswona swilo swi va makhadi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Eka MeisterTask, tlilika vito ra phurojeke, hlawula Export project u humesa CSV, kutani u yi namarhela. Swiyenge swi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swilo swo tsundzuxa swa yona, siku ro hetelela, muaveriwa na swikombiso; mintirho leyi hetiweke yi hlayisa siku ra yona ro hetisa. CSV leyi tsariweke ku nghenisiwa ka MeisterTask na yona ya tirha.
import-board-instruction-monday: Eka monday.com, pfula menyu ya bodo, hlawula More actions na Export board to Excel (na ku pfuxeta na swintirhwana loko u swi lava), kutani u hlawula fayili ya .xlsx. Khalomu ya Status yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintlawa yi va tindlela; vanhu, masiku, nxaxamelo wa nkarhi na swikombiso swi hlayisa tindhawu ta swona, tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela naswona ku pfuxeta ku va mimbulavulo.
import-board-instruction-notion: Eka Notion, pfula database tanihi tluka hinkwaro, hlawula ••• na Export, hlawula Markdown & CSV, u hlawula fayili ya .zip leyi yi dawunilodaka, kumbe CSV yin'we ya database ku suka eka yona, kumbe u namarhela CSV yoleyo. Khalomu leyi vuriwaka Status yi va minxaxamelo (loko yi nga ri kona, khalomu yo sungula leyi fanaka na select yi endla tano, naswona xiviko xa ku nghenisa xi vula leswaku i yihi); mintila yi va makhadi swin'we na nhloko-mhaka ya wona, swikombiso tanihi swikombiso, vanhu tanihi swirho, masiku, na tsalwa ra tluka tanihi nhlamuselo; tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela. Vuxaka, swifaniso na swihlanganisi a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Eka Nullboard, pfula bodo, hlawula Export this board... eka menyu, pfula fayili ya .nbx eka xilulamisi xa matsalwa u namarhela leswi nga eka yona. Minxaxamelo yi va minxaxamelo naswona swilo swo tsundzuxa swi va makhadi: layini yo sungula ya xitsundzuxo i nhloko-mhaka ya khadi naswona leswi saleke i nhlamuselo ya rona. Xitsundzuxo xa raw xi kuma xikombiso raw. Fayili leyi nga ni tibodo to tala yi nghenisa bodo ya yona yo sungula.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Eka Obsidian, pfula fayili ya bodo ya Kanban tanihi Markdown (kumbe u pfula fayili ya .md eka xilulamisi xa matsalwa), kutani u namarhela hinkwayo. Tindlela ti va minxaxamelo na mpimo wa makhadi ya tona, makhadi ma hlayisa swikombiso swa wona, masiku, nkoka, swivandla na nxaxamelo wo kambela, naswona Archive yi va makhadi lama nga eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namarheta JSON ya nhlengeleto wa work-packages wa OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Swiyimo swi hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona ti-work package ti hundzuka tikhadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namarhela OPML outline, hilaha Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq na ti-outliner tin'wana ti yi humesaka hakona. Swilo swa le henhla swi va minxaxamelo, vana va swona va va makhadi lama nga ni nhlamuselo ya xitsundzuxo, naswona swilo swa le hansi swi va minxaxamelo yo kambela. Swilo leswi hetiweke swi nghenisiwa swi ri swi hetisiwile.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namarhela fayili ya Org mode, hilaha Emacs, Orgzly kumbe Beorg swi yi tsalaka hakona. Tinhloko ta le henhla ti va minxaxamelo naswona tinhloko ta xiyimo xa vumbirhi ti va makhadi. TODO na DONE, nkoka, swikombiso, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED swa hlayisiwa, naswona swibokisana swo funghela na tinhloko ta le hansi swi va minxaxamelo yo kambela.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Eka Pivotal Tracker, pfula thebe ya MORE ya phurojeke u hlawula Export CSV (kumbe u hlawula switori u hlawula Bulk Actions, CSV), kutani u namarhela CSV. Xiyimo xin'wana na xin'wana xa xitori xi va nxaxamelo naswona switori swi va makhadi, swin'we na muxaka na swikombiso swa swona, vini, mukomberi, masiku, mimbulavulo, mintirho na swisivela; Estimate yi va Story points naswona ku phindha ku va ti-sprint.
import-board-instruction-plane: Eka Plane, pfula Workspace Settings, hlawula Exports, humesa tiphurojeke tanihi JSON, CSV kumbe Excel u dawuniloda fayili ya .zip, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo, kumbe fayili yin'we ku suka endzeni ka yona, kumbe u namarhela JSON kumbe CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo, tiphurojeke ti va tindlela, naswona swiphiqo swi va makhadi swin'we na xihlawulekisi, mutswari, vaaveriwa, swikombiso, masiku, tilinki na mimbulavulo swa swona; nkoka, xilinganiso, xirhendzevutani na mojulu swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela. Ku humesa ka Plane a ku na tinhlamuselo kumbe swihlanganisi, hikwalaho a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Eka Quire, pfula menyu ya phurojeke u hlawula Export CSV, kutani u namarhela CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swintirhwana swa yona tanihi makhadi ya vana, vaaveriwa, swikombiso tanihi swikombiso, masiku yo sungula, yo hetelela na yo hetisa, nhlamuselo na nkoka tanihi xivandla xa ku tiendlela. Mimbulavulo na swihlanganisi a swi kona eka CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Eka Redmine, pfula Issues ta phurojeke, hlawula Also available in: CSV ehansi ka nxaxamelo, hlawula tikhalomu (All columns, na Description) u humesa, kutani u namarhela CSV. Redmine yi thya tikhalomu hi ririmi ra wena, hikwalaho veka ririmi ra wena ri va Xinghezi eka My account u nga si humesa. Xiyimo xin'wana na xin'wana xi va nxaxamelo naswona swiphiqo swi va makhadi, swin'we na tracker tanihi xikombiso, muaveriwa, mutsari, masiku, ntirho wa mutswari na swiphiqo leswi yelanaka; nkoka, xiyenge, vhezheni leyi kongomisiweke, nkarhi lowu ringanyetiweke, % Done na swivandla swa ku tiendlela swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Eka Super Productivity, pfula Settings, kutani Sync & Backup, hlawula Export Data u namarhela leswi nga eka fayili ya sp-backup .json. Phurojeke yin'wana na yin'wana yi va ndlela naswona mintirho yi va makhadi eka To Do, In Progress, Backlog kumbe Done, swin'we na swilo swo tsundzuxa, swikombiso, siku ro hetelela, nkarhi lowu tirhisiweke na swintirhwana swa yona; mintirho leyi nga eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale yi va makhadi lama nga eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Eka Taiga, pfula Admin > Project > Export u dawuniloda ku humesiwa ka phurojeke (pfula fayili ya .json.gz ku sungula), kutani u namarhela JSON ya yona. Swiyimo swa switori swa vatirhisi swi va minxaxamelo, switori swa vatirhisi swi va makhadi na mintirho ya swona tanihi swintirhwana, ti-epic na swiphiqo swi kuma tindlela ta swona, naswona ti-sprint, swikombiso, mimbulavulo na swihlawulekisi swa ku tiendlela swa ta. Swihlanganisi a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Eka Tasks.org, pfula Settings, Backups u hlawula Export tasks, kutani u namarhela leswi nga eka fayili ya .json. Minxaxamelo yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swilo swo tsundzuxa, swikombiso, masiku, mimbulavulo na swintirhwana swa yona; mintirho leyi hetiweke yi hlayisa siku ra yona ro hetisa, naswona nkoka wu va xivandla xa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namarheta vuyelo bya task export: nxaxamelo wa JSON kumbe ntiro wun’we eka layini yin’wana ni yin’wana. Mintirho leyi hetiweke yi ya eka Done, project na priority swi hundzuka swikombiso, annotations yi hundzuka mavonelo, kasi depends yi hundzuka ku titshega hi mintirho leyi sivelaka.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Eka Teamwork.com, tata xikombiso xa ku nghenisa mintirho xa Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) u xi hlayisa tanihi .xlsx, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo. Minxaxamelo ya mintirho yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi; ntirho lowu sungulaka hi -, # kumbe > wu va xintirhwana xa ntirho lowu nga ehenhla ka wona (--, ## kumbe >> xiyimo xin'we ehansi). Vaaveriwa, masiku na swikombiso swi hlayisa tindhawu ta swona; Priority, Estimated time na Complete swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Eka TickTick, pfula Settings, Account, Backup & Import u endla vuhlayiselo bya nseketelo, kutani u namarhela fayili ya CSV. Nxaxamelo wun'wana na wun'wana wa TickTick wu va ndlela naswona tikhalomu ta wona ti va minxaxamelo; mintirho yi hlayisa swikombiso swa yona, masiku, nxaxamelo wo kambela, nkoka na swintirhwana.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namarheta fayili ya todo.txt: ntirho wun'we eka layini yin'wana ni yin'wana, hi ndlela leyi xitirhisiwa xa todo.txt ni switirhisiwa leswi fambelanaka na xona swi tsalaka ha yona. Mintirho leyi hetiweke ("x") yi ya eka leyi hetiweke, +project na @context swi hundzuka malebulu, (A) yi hundzuka lebulu ya ku rhangisa, kasi due: na t: swi hundzuka masiku ya makumu ni ya ku sungula.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Eka Vikunja, pfula Settings, hlawula Data Export u dawuniloda fayili ya .zip leyi yi ku rhumelaka yona, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo, kumbe u namarhela data.json leyi nga endzeni ka yona. Swibakiti swa Kanban swi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swikombiso, vaaveriwa, masiku, nhlamuselo, minxaxamelo ya mintirho tanihi minxaxamelo yo kambela na mimbulavulo; nkoka, phesente leyi hetiweke na ku hetisiwa swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela. Swihlanganisi a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Eka Wrike, humesa phurojeke kumbe folidara eka Excel, kumbe u tata xikombiso xa ku nghenisa xa Excel xa Wrike, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo ya .xlsx. Mintila ya folidara na phurojeke yi va tindlela, Status yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na Key, ntirho wa mutswari, vaaveriwa, masiku yo sungula na yo hetelela, swiboho na nhlamuselo swa yona; Priority, Duration na tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namarheta JSON ya ku humesa ka nxaxamelo wa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Ti-stage ti hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona ti-item ti hundzuka tikhadi.

r-wrike-workflow-note: Ndlela ya ntirho ya Wrike i nxaxamelo wa swiyimo, xin'wana na xin'wana xi ri eka ntlawa wa Active, Completed, Deferred kumbe Cancelled. Ku humesa ku tsala minxaxamelo ya bodo leyi tanihi yin'we, leyi thyiweke hi bodo, eka JSON leyi API ya Wrike yi yi vuyisaka ya tindlela ta ntirho: endla ndlela yoleyo ya ntirho eka Wrike u nga si nghenisa ku humesa ka Excel ka Wrike ka bodo, leswaku swiyimo swa yona swi tirhisiwa. Ku nghenisa ku hlaya JSON yoleyo leyi namarheriweke laha henhla, ku suka eka WeKan kumbe eka GET /workflows ya Wrike, eka bodo leyi hlawuriweke: xiyimo lexi nga riki na nxaxamelo xi va nxaxamelo, naswona nawu wu fungha khadi ri hetisiwile loko ri rhurhiseriwa eka xiyimo xa Completed kumbe Cancelled naswona ri nga hetisiwanga eka xa Active kumbe Deferred. Milawu ya Wrike ya yoxe ya ku tiendlekela a yi koti ku humesiwa eka Wrike.

recovery-no-events: Ku hava swiendlakalo swa ku vuyisa leswi tsariweke. Database yi hanyile kahle.

scrum-backlog-help: Hlela ntirho hi xiyimo xa ntirho lowu salaka. Avela makhadi eka sprint leyi pulaniweke kumbe leyi tirhaka.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Khansela sprint leyi? Makhadi ya yona ma hlayisa vuxirho bya wona ku kondza ma averiwa nakambe.
scrum-confirm-close: Pfala sprint leyi u hlayisa mimbuyelo ya yona? Makhadi lama nga hetiwangiki ma ta rhurhiseriwa eka ndhawu leyi hlawuriweke.
scrum-daily-empty: A ku si tsariwa swivoniwa swa siku na siku eka sprint leyi.
scrum-daily-observations: Mpimo wa siku na siku na ntirho lowu saleke (swivoniwa)
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Xivoniwa xo sungula lexi tsariweke xa siku rin'wana na rin'wana ra UTC; masiku lama pfumalekaka a ma kombisiwi. Swivoniwa a swi tsali ku cinca hinkwako kumbe nhlayo ya makumu ya siku. Swilinganiso leswi nga tiviwiki a hi zero.
scrum-daily-observations-help: Bara rin'wana na rin'wana ri kombisa xivoniwa xo sungula lexi tsariweke xa siku ra UTC, hi nkarhi lowu kombisiweke. Masiku lama pfumalekaka a ma kombisiwi. Swivoniwa leswi a swi tsali ku cinca hinkwako kumbe ku kombisa nhlayo ya makumu ya siku. Swilinganiso leswi nga tiviwiki a hi zero. Tirhisa xiendlo xa Humesa xa xiyenge lexi eka swivoniwa swa siku na siku; xiendlo xa Humesa xa bara ra switirho xi humesa mimbuyelo ya sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Swivoniwa swa 366 swa sweswinyana ntsena hi swona swi kombisiwaka.

scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ ka __total__ ka ku cinca ku tsariwile, __pending__ a ku tsariwanga, naswona __conflicted__ ku cinciwile hi un'wana ku sukela kwalaho.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Hlayisa bodo hilaha yi nga hakona

scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ku tlherisela endzhaku ku vuyisa rhekhodo yin'wana na yin'wana leyi cinciweke hilaha a yi ri hakona khale; swi nyikiwa ntsena loko ku ri hava un'wana loyi a cinceke tirhekhodo toleto ku sukela kwalaho. Ku hlayisa bodo hilaha yi nga hakona ku susa ntirho lowu yimeke naswona a ku cinci tirhekhodo. Hi ndlela yihi na yihi, swi tsariwa eka Phanele ya valawuri, Swiphiqo, Ku Vuyisela.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ku tlherisela endzhaku, ku endla nakambe kumbe ku vuyisela ku cinca ka Scrum ku yimile hikwalaho ka ku kanetana. Ku lulamisa ka Scrum eka bodo leyi ku siviwile ku kondza swi tlhantlhiwa.

scrum-history-job-running: Ku tlherisela endzhaku kumbe ku tlhela u endla ku cinca lokukulu: __done__ eka tilayini ta matimu ta __total__

scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Khadi i ra bodo yin'wana naswona ri tshikiwile ri nga cinciwanga: __reference__
scrum-import-discard: Khansela ku nghenisa loku nga hetiwangiki
scrum-import-into-board: Nghenisa ku pulana ka Scrum eka bodo leyi
